decisions.reason: As a publicly announced flagship close to the core business, it involves high sunk investment and public commitment, so escalation makes dropping unlikely.
It lacks flagship public commitment and likely has limited sunk costs, so management can drop it without justifying past decisions.
Presented as a flagship/focus, it creates public commitment and high investment, leading management to persist despite possible disappointing results.
With no public commitment and limited investment, there is little to lose and nothing to justify, so it is easier to drop if results disappoint.
